checks: Cursor input rejects unknown/mixed scopes, forged shapes and accessors before reading descriptors
One actual SQLite search yields 21 distinct candidates across 10/10/1 with no duplicate page or false whole-library count
Replaying a cursor preserves aliases and next token, performs no new ANN/keyword search and changes no facts
Cursor cannot cross query/filter/run or turn into answer-enrichment permission
Changed/deleted slots are excluded; a newly inserted matching row cannot replace a frozen candidate
Malformed individual records and mirrored answer conflicts do not poison healthy search results
Small partial candidate windows retain incomplete coverage through later pages and SQL-level exclusions
Candidate-budget exhaustion remains explicit even after all 50 known candidates were paged
The actual row-mapping boundary isolates invalid JSON and retains the raw candidate cap after exclusions
A document that becomes malformed between pages is isolated even when the canonical mapper throws
Permission revocation/cancel/storage failure remain terminal for the call with no leaked storage detail
Bounded 32-token registry evicts explicitly and never stores source text or grants read authority
Sanitization-time source changes publish neither stale candidates nor new alias authority
Chinese question index migrates pre-existing facts and ANDs every metadata filter before LIMIT
Short Chinese, formula numbers and literal percent/underscore preserve keyword semantics and explicit scan fallback
Reviewed full-context text is searchable; malformed legacy JSON does not break index writes
Canonical INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and transaction rollback keep derived index consistent
Missing index is rebuilt from canonical facts and repeated initialization is idempotent
Stable ordering and whole filtered count allow disjoint pages without pre-LIMIT filter loss
Invalid filters, enums, limits, unknown fields and accessors fail without broadening search
Unsupported FTS alone falls back; unrelated migration errors roll back and remain visible
Conservative identity ignores record IDs and CRLF only, preserves printed question numbers and mathematical text
Complete document identity includes all six projections and image bytes but excludes source/record/anchor identity
Legacy summary, incomplete projection, damaged document and mirror conflicts have no duplicate key
Changing answers or source version never grants trusted reuse and always changes the existing fact version
Candidate grouping is bounded, stable, counts distinct records and never hides unsupported questions
Question context strict descriptors reject selectors, unknown fields, accessors and bad versions
Existing SQLite question facts yield sanitized search without answer, IDs, heuristic score or teacher approval claims
Pi exposes and forwards strict grade/type/difficulty/source filters with ten-item bound and honest hasMore
Only discovered matching alias/version reads complete necessary answer and source, no writes
Pi reports duplicate candidates using only returned aliases, without exposing local keys or claiming verified answers
Repeated search keeps aliases; bookmark version is not the content SHA; actual fact changes refuse old references
Source changes during sanitization fail without publishing new aliases or stale sources
Empty, cancellation, stale run and read failures remain explicit and do not expose host errors
Question source typed IPC rejects non-main and unknown inputs before touching the store
Question capability identity supports old unmarked sessions and refuses removal, wrong tools or unknown branch marker before opening history
Oversized full answer is refused rather than silently truncated into a complete answer claim
Actual Pi history gains a question marker once; removal and unknown-version restore refuse with JSONL bytes unchanged
Read rejects conflicting answer or analysis mirrors even in legacy v1, without rewriting identity or stored facts
Complete originals reject each statement/answer/analysis conflict before source work; matching text remains unproved
Fact consistency preserves legacy hashes and v1 summaries and never normalizes or repairs source text
Pi isolates conflicting candidates without corrupted text, source identity or alias; exact restoration recovers without fact writes
Changed source regions reset all six teacher coverage flags without destroying notes or mutating the previous confirmed projection
Complete projection v2 has six explicit reviewed sections; missing conditions or forged coverage never become a complete context
Question document preserves formula, figure, table, choices, subquestion and independent answer origin
Question document rejects forged approval, unsupported version, empty source anchors, paths and invalid geometry
Question document rejects duplicate IDs, sparse/accessor/cyclic data, excessive depth, nodes and UTF8 bytes
Legacy question SHA is identical; figure, formula, page, source, engine and answer-origin changes invalidate new CAS
Same SQLite additive migration preserves old rows/defaults and is idempotent for fresh and old schemas
Pi refuses incomplete structured original without cloud text/figure/source leakage or a correctness claim
scope: Production shared contract/provider, SQLite-owned synthetic facts and bounded per-run continuation. No model response or natural recall benchmark.
